about.subtitle: Professional summary
about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a technical specialist with over 8 years of web testing and 5+ years of PHP development experience, bridging the gap between quality assurance, DevOps practices, and systems engineering.
about.p2: My expertise lies in architecting scalable CI/CD pipelines, managing containerized (Docker, Minikube) and virtualized (VMware, KVM) environments, and designing automated E2E testing frameworks (Playwright, Robot Framework). Whether working on-premise or in the cloud, my goal is to build highly reliable, automated, and maintainable infrastructure.
